name: g_sharedFormatBuffer
comment: Shared 256-byte scratch buffer for formatted text. The Squirrel compiler writes error messages into it with func_00100188(buffer, 0x100, fmt, ...) before storing the pointer in ScriptCompiler+0x70; Ui_Window_InitHeader also formats a window title into it.
evidence: Literals 0x00185DCC, 0x001868EC, 0x00187124 all resolve to 0x008385F0; Script_SqCompiler_Statement calls func_00100188(0x008385F0,0x100,fmt,...) then self[0x1c]=0x008385F0; Ui_Window_InitHeader formats into the same address and stores it at self+0x70; the next separately referenced BSS global is 0x008386F0, so the buffer is exactly 0x100 bytes.

name: g_scriptErrorState
comment: Global Squirrel error-state record (140 bytes): +0 error flag, +4 VM pointer, +8 value vtable (0x00782514), +0xC char[128] formatted error text. func_005766A4 returns its address; bindings set the flag and copy type/arity errors here, and VM creation clears it.
evidence: Script_GetVmOrThrow at 0x005766A8 returns 0x0083876C through literal 0x00576704 and resets +0/+4/+8/+0xC; Script_GetIntArg and the bindings write the VM at +4 and a 0x80-byte message at +0xC via func_005766A4(); the next referenced BSS global is 0x008387F8, giving exactly 0x8C bytes.
